At UIE we implement Qlaas, which connects AI agents to the systems your teams already use. You decide what each agent can do, which decisions need approval and how to check the result.

One workflow we would pilot with finance administration teams:

Finance administration
  Delegated: Match invoices to purchase orders and receipts, then prepare the payment instruction.
  Stays with you: Payment release, suspected fraud and unmatched records remain with the finance owner.
  Exception: A supplier invoice exceeds the purchase order.

The page shows how that exception is handled and which records prove the case is complete.

See the finance administration workflow: https://uieglobal.com/solutions/finance-administration/?utm_source=outreach&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=pilot-2026-11&utm_content=t1-finance
Discuss a pilot: https://uieglobal.com/?pilot=Finance%20administration&utm_source=outreach&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=pilot-2026-11&utm_content=t1-finance
